entries.clue: It holds a lot of hammers
Harmonize, like part of a fruit salad
Where Reagan worked as a sportscaster
Comic strip set in North Dakota?
Put a credit card through the machine
Young fowl with weapons of outrageous fortune
Be a complement for a beard?
Mario of the San Antonio Spurs
On the left side of the no. line
All you need to be a suave bartender?
